bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for product price text
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the price paragraph within each product card (e.g., .product-card:nth-child(1) > p)
Observe the light gray text (#aaaaaa) on a white background (#ffffff)
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Price text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the background per WCAG 2.1 AA.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Price text has a contrast ratio of 2.32:1 (foreground #aaaaaa on background #ffffff), which fails the required 4.5:1 ratio.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for .product-card:nth-child(1) > p, change color from #aaaaaa to #747474 (4.67:1 on #ffffff; measured 2.32:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Product images missing alternative text
steps_to_reproduce: Observe that the element has no alt attribute
Repeat for the green shoe image
bugLogs.expected_behavior: All informative product images must have a descriptive alt attribute or be marked as decorative with alt="" or role="presentation".
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The and elements lack alt attributes, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, and role overrides.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image, e.g., Add alt="Red running shoe" to img[src$='shoe-red.jpg'] and Add alt="Green running shoe" to img[src$='shoe-green.jpg']. If the images are purely decorative, set alt="" and role="presentation".
